name: Feature request
about: Suggest an application to add, or a change to how the playbooks work
title: ''
labels: ''
assignees: ''

---

**What would you like**
A clear description of the application or change you are proposing.

**If you are proposing an application**
 - Name and project URL
 - License
 - How it is built or installed: distribution package, source build, prebuilt
   binary, Python package, AppImage
 - Which platforms it supports: ARM 64-bit, ARM 32-bit, x86_64
 - Whether it is packaged in Debian already

Applications that build from source on ARM are the most work to maintain, so
say what you know about how it builds.

**What problem does it solve**
Why this belongs in a station build rather than being installed by hand.

**Alternatives you have considered**
Other applications that do the same job, and why this one is preferable.

**Additional context**
Anything else worth knowing.
